description: Read-only moldability fit for one part mesh, in the part local frame (the same frame as list_faces). Searches bounding-box axes, large planar normals, and an icosphere (about 80 directions, deduped within 5°, d and -d are one axis). The chosen pull has the least occluded undercut area. Scores within max(2% of the part area, 25 mm²) of that best are tied; box axes and large planar normals win the tie over an icosphere sample, and drafted area breaks the rest. Fit is still good (0 undercut regions), fixable (1 to 4), or not_a_fit (5 or more), plus undercutCount, undercutArea, draftedArea, pull, and pullSource. Pass pull [x, y, z] to score that axis instead and keep its sign. The same result includes wall: a local thickness per triangle, nominal (mode, or the median when no thickness dominates the interior band), max, min, mean, median, and thin and thick regions. Thickness below 0.6× nominal is thin and above 1.5× nominal is thick. Wall thickness follows the geometric normal of each triangle. A stamp only flips that side when it points the other way, so one stamp on a curved face does not steer every facet. A triangle whose own normal is within 0.5° of perpendicular to the pull is not an undercut, and an undercut needs another triangle covering that point. A geometric check for later molding slices, not a supplier DFM. parting on the same result classifies every face as core or cavity by complete visibility (core along +pull, cavity along -pull). A wall within 0.5° of vertical takes the role of the labelled neighbour it can reach. There is no zero-draft class. One outer parting loop is kept. Stamped edges keep their names. sideActions on the same result clusters those undercuts into slides and lifters, each with a suggested pull. That split is a heuristic. count, slideCount, and lifterCount are the numbers a later tooling adder can use. moldDraft on the same result flags side walls below 1° of draft and lists ejector-pin and sleeve candidate positions. Those candidates are a heuristic. It does not edit CAD draft.

part_id.description: Opaque surf id of the part to score. Omit for the active part.

pull.description: Override pull direction [x, y, z] in the part local frame. The vector is normalized and its sign is kept. Omit to search.

name: mold_fit
